exposure: family history of congenital hearing loss
outcome: Failure rates of the first otoacoustic emissions (OAE) test
finding: Female infants, infants born vaginally, and those with a family history of hearing impairment had higher failure rates on their first OAE test.
mod_finding: Infants born vaginally had a 1.5-fold higher failure rate on their first OAE test compared to infants born via cesarean delivery.
